method_change_relative_to_v2: none; v3 changes only confirmation provenance and seed sampling after discovering that the four v1 seeds had already been executed

scientific_method.k3_measurement: streaming exact direct-prefix measurement through degree 3
scientific_method.witness_bank: four unit K3 convex-hull residual witnesses, one per candidate final-stage class, frozen for each target before any K4 candidate output
scientific_method.k4_acquisition: stream exact one-step active lifts from measured degree-3 prefixes and retain only witness-projected scalar endpoint/interactions
scientific_method.hierarchy: nonnegative K-local order marginals with simplex and adjacent-level marginal consistency
scientific_method.certificate: proof-safe infinity-norm multi-witness LP with corrected dual lower bound
scientific_method.pair_decision: for every unordered pair, solve both precedence classes without access to the generating chronology; exactly one excluded class implies the opposite orientation, neither implies abstention, both implies invalidity
scientific_method.chronology_decision: return a history only when all six pair orientations are inferred and form a transitive total order

terminal_validation.rule: each orientation-class local-order LP primal must match an independently solved convex hull over the complete permutations in that orientation class within tolerance
terminal_validation.euclidean_soundness: each certified lower bound must be no larger than the direct exact Euclidean vertex-class distance beyond tolerance

complexity_scope.terminal_K_equals_N: exact but factorial in interaction acquisition
complexity_scope.N_greater_than_K_limitation: exact true-endpoint certification additionally requires control of omitted interactions above degree K; no universal finite tail bound is claimed

fresh_confirmation_change_policy: after this v3 lock, do not change witness construction, interaction degree, two-sided pairwise decision rule, LP formulation or correction, thresholds, target histories, outcome tiers, or validity rules based on fresh confirmation outputs
